stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Accepted: Initial mockup accepted
    Accepted --> WorkingDraft: User starts editing
    WorkingDraft --> PendingAgent: Request AI revision
    PendingAgent --> Proposed: Agent saves validated proposal
    PendingAgent --> WorkingDraft: User resumes editing or cancels request
    Proposed --> Accepted: User accepts proposal
    Proposed --> WorkingDraft: User rejects proposal
    WorkingDraft --> Accepted: User discards working draft
    Accepted --> [*]: User deletes mockup
    WorkingDraft --> [*]: User deletes mockup
    Proposed --> [*]: User deletes mockup
    note right of Accepted
        Accepted SVG is the formal visual source
        PNG is derived evidence only
    end note
    note right of WorkingDraft
        Working SVG remains recoverable
        Annotations stay separate
    end note
